subject: MAP: marketplace purchase steps & evaluation timeline - Acme Cloud
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@acmecloud.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: marketplace purchase steps & evaluation timeline

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Acme Cloud is proceeding with a short evaluation and we want to map the marketplace procurement steps so legal, procurement, and our reseller partner are aligned. I attached a one-page MAP (MAP_AcmeCloud_v1.xlsx) with a suggested timeline.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm which marketplace paths you support (AWS, Azure, GCP) and any differences in billing/terms.
- Provide a short procurement checklist we can hand to our procurement team (SOW, pricing SKU, invoice flow).
- Identify the expected time-to-listing for each marketplace and whether we need a reseller to complete listing on our behalf.

We'd like weekly checkpoint calls — same time each week — to track owners and blockers. Proposed first call: Wed Apr 1, 10:00 AM PT.

Attachments: MAP_AcmeCloud_v1.xlsx; procurement-marketplace-checklist.pdf

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Platform Partnerships | Acme Cloud
elena.park@acmecloud.com

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@acmecloud.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: marketplace purchase steps & evaluation timeline

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clear MAP. We're ready to run the weekly checkpoints and I've pulled together an initial action list below with owners and rough ETA. Wed Apr 1, 10:00 AM PT works for our team — sending a calendar invite.

Quick answers to your asks:
- We support AWS, Azure, and GCP marketplaces. Differences: AWS and Azure allow direct marketplace billing; GCP typically uses a reseller flow for marketplace paid subscriptions (we'll confirm exact SKU mapping).
- Attached checklist is our procurement summary; I added a short notes column matching your checklist.
- Typical listing times: AWS 7-10 business days (when ready), Azure ~10-14 business days, GCP via reseller 5-12 days depending on reseller lead time.

Initial action items (owners / ETA):
- Marketplace listing & SKUs: Marcus Lin — provide SKU matrix and billing flow by Fri Apr 2.
- Legal redlines & terms alignment: Laura Bennett — review DocuSign/MAP and flag any non-standard clauses by Mon Apr 5.
- Trial provisioning & sandbox access for Acme: Priyom Das — sandbox creds and usage guide by Tue Apr 6.
- Reseller coordination (if required for GCP): I'll intro Steve Miller from ResellPartner during Wed's call; he can own the reseller onboarding steps.

I'll bring a short checklist and shared Drive link to Wed's call.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Strategic Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Prep for Acme MAP checkpoint (Wed Apr 1 10:00 AM PT)

Team —

Prep items before the external checkpoint tomorrow: please review and add any constraints to the shared MAP doc. I'll run the meeting and keep it strict 30 minutes.

Pre-call checklist:
- Marcus: paste SKU table + initial listing docs into Drive (link below). Confirm any additional metadata Acme needs for AWS/Azure.
- Laura: quick scan for third-party reseller clauses (GCP) and any data residency notes that could affect listing.
- Priyom: confirm sandbox provisioning process and cooldown period for load tests. Provide a short runbook (3 bullets) we can share live.
- Me: intro to ResellPartner and owner of GCP flow on the call.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b-MAP-Acme
Shared MAP: MAP_AcmeCloud_v1.xlsx (I uploaded a version with our column comments).

If you can't make the call, ping here and include your takedowns. We'll need Marcus' SKU table by EOD today to walk through on Wed.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Elena Park <elena.park@acmecloud.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@acmecloud.com>, Steve Miller <steve.miller@resellpartner.io>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: marketplace purchase steps & evaluation timeline

Karthik / team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for scheduling. Confirming Wed Apr 1 10:00 AM PT (I've accepted the invite). A few notes from procurement before the call:
- Please include pricing SKUs and whether subscriptions will be metered vs. flat (Marcus).
- We need a single point of contact for marketplace billing questions (billing@redwood.ai OK?).
- ResellPartner will assist on GCP — Steve, can you confirm you have the sandbox access request and procurement contact?

Next steps for the call — agenda: 1) MAP owners and timeline, 2) SKU & billing flow, 3) legal/terms quick check, 4) reseller onboarding path (if needed).

Attachments: procurement-marketplace-checklist.pdf (we added a procurement contact template).

Elena
